tool-profile-reuse.title: Matching configurations
tool-profile-reuse.intro: These profiles match the complete fixed configuration. Enabled state and dispatch eligibility at this read are shown separately.
tool-profile-reuse.select_required: Choose a configuration before explicitly enabling or opening it. The first match is not selected automatically.
tool-profile-reuse.history_hint: Revoked profiles are available for review and cannot be enabled directly. Explicitly create a new configuration through the existing registration flow.
tool-profile-reuse.invalid_response: The existing-configuration response could not be verified. Read it again.
tool-profile-reuse.loading: Finding complete configuration matches for the current project and node…
tool-profile-reuse.query_failed: Existing configurations could not be read. Read them again before choosing an existing configuration or creating one.
tool-profile-reuse.empty: No reusable paused or enabled configuration was found. Explicitly register a new configuration through the existing flow.
tool-profile-reuse.existing_conflict: An identical paused or enabled configuration already exists. Read current matches and choose explicitly; the name draft is retained.
